assumptions.choice: Morning trend is evaluated on the first bar at or after 11:30 exchange time using current bar Close, SMA(20), and SMA(20) from 4 bars prior.
assumptions.reason: Ensures exact evaluation at the end of the morning window (11:30) in intraday 15-minute bars.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss is checked in next() against bar Low (for long) or High (for short) using 2% off the order execution price.
assumptions.reason: Implements the spec requirement for a fixed 2% stop-loss checked each bar.

assumptions.choice: Midday entry window is evaluated between 11:30 and 13:30 inclusive.
assumptions.reason: Fulfills specification requirement to allow entries during midday window up to 13:30.
